description: This file defines the RemoteHostServiceHandle class, which extends ServiceHandle to represent a service running on a remote host, including methods for handling remote IP and override methods indicating the service's process and host location.

classes.name: RemoteHostServiceHandle
classes.description: A class representing a service handle for services located on remote hosts, extending the ServiceHandle base class with remote IP management and specific process/location identification.

methods.name: RemoteHostServiceHandle
methods.description: Constructor initializing name, ipc, event, and remote IP address, optionally with visibility.

methods.name: getRemoteIp
methods.description: Returns the IP address of the remote host where the service is located.

methods.name: setRemoteIp
methods.description: Sets the IP address of the remote host.

methods.name: isSameProcess
methods.description: Indicates whether the service runs in the same process (overridden to false).

methods.name: isLocalHost
methods.description: Indicates whether the service is on the local host (overridden to false).

methods.name: isRemoteHost
methods.description: Indicates whether the service is on a remote host (overridden to true).
